info.name: MLOps Monorepo APIs
info.description:
Postman collection for the MLOps monorepo serving APIs:

- **Pizza Price Prediction API** (Linear Regression) - predicts pizza price from diameter
- **Spam Email Classification API** (Logistic Regression) - classifies emails as SPAM or NOT spam
- **Market Segmentation API** (K-Means Clustering) - segments customers into behavioral groups
- **Recommendation Engine API** (Apriori) - generates product recommendations from transaction patterns
- **Anomaly Detection API** (PCA) - detects anomalous server metrics using dimensionality reduction
- **Robot Maze Navigation API** (Q-Learning) - navigates a robot through a maze using reinforcement learning

## Setup

1. Run the APIs locally:
   ```bash
   make serve-all   # Starts all APIs on ports 8000-8005
   ```
   Or individually:
   ```bash
   make serve-pizza                  # http://localhost:8000
   make serve-spam                   # http://localhost:8001
   make serve-market-segmentation    # http://localhost:8002
   make serve-recommendation-engine  # http://localhost:8003
   make serve-anomaly-detection      # http://localhost:8004
   make serve-robot-maze             # http://localhost:8005
   ```
2. Or port-forward from Kubernetes:
   ```bash
   make k8s-port-forward-pizza       # http://localhost:8080
   make k8s-port-forward-spam        # http://localhost:8081
   ```
3. Update the collection variables to match your environment.
